versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֤י הַגֶּ֨בֶר֙ רָאָ֣ה עֳנִ֔י בְּשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
controles.kjv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
controles.livre: Eu sou o homem que viu a aflição pela vara de seu furor.

controles.web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
controles.kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
controles.livre: Guiou-me e levou-me a trevas, e não à luz.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ס

controles.web: Surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day.
controles.kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
controles.livre: Com certeza se virou contra mim, revirou sua mão o dia todo.

controles.web: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.
controles.kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
controles.livre: Fez envelhecer minha carne e minha pele, quebrou meus ossos.

controles.web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with gall and travail.
controles.kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
controles.livre: Edificou contra mim, e cercou -me de fel e de trabalho.

controles.web: He has made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
controles.kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
controles.livre: Fez-me habitar em lugares escuros, como os que já morrera há muito tempo.

versos.hebraico: גָּדַ֧ר בַּעֲדִ֛י וְלֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א הִכְבִּ֥יד נְחָשְׁתִּֽי׃

controles.web: He has walled me about, that I can’t go out; he has made my chain heavy.
controles.kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
controles.livre: Cercou-me por todos lados, e não posso sair; tornou pesados os meus grilhões.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֣ם כִּ֤י אֶזְעַק֙ וַאֲשַׁוֵּ֔עַ שָׂתַ֖ם תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

controles.web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
controles.kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
controles.livre: Até quando clamo e dou vozes, fechou os ouvidos à minha oração.

controles.web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone; he has made my paths crooked.
controles.kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
controles.livre: Cercou meus caminhos com pedras lavradas, retorceu as minhas veredas.

versos.hebraico: דֹּ֣ב אֹרֵ֥ב הוּא֙ לִ֔י אריה בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃

controles.web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
controles.kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
controles.livre: Foi para mim como um urso que espia, como um leão escondido.

controles.web: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he has made me desolate.
controles.kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
controles.livre: Desviou meus caminhos, e fez-me em pedaços; deixou-me desolado.

controles.web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
controles.kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
controles.livre: Armou seu arco, e me pôs como alvo para a flecha.

controles.web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
controles.kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
controles.livre: Fez entrar em meus rins as flechas de sua aljava.

controles.web: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.
controles.kjv: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
controles.livre: Servi de escárnio a todo o meu povo, de canção ridícula deles o dia todo.

controles.web: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.
controles.kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
controles.livre: Fartou-me de amarguras, embebedou-me de absinto.

controles.web: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he has covered me with ashes.
controles.kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
controles.livre: Quebrou os meus dentes com cascalho, cobriu-me de cinzas.

controles.web: You have removed my soul far off from peace; I forgot prosperity.
controles.kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
controles.livre: E afastou minha alma da paz, fez-me esquecer da boa vida.

controles.web: I said, My strength is perished, and my expectation from Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:
controles.livre: Então eu disse: Pereceram minha força e minha esperança no SENHOR.

controles.web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
controles.kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
controles.livre: Lembra-te da minha aflição e do meu sofrimento, do absinto e do fel.

controles.web: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
controles.kjv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
controles.livre: Minha alma se lembra e se abate em mim.

controles.web: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.
controles.kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
controles.livre: Disto me recordarei na minha mente, por isso terei esperança:

versos.hebraico: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽיו׃

controles.web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
controles.kjv: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
controles.livre: É pelas bondades do SENHOR que não somos consumidos, porque suas misericórdias não têm fim.

controles.web: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
controles.kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
controles.livre: Elas são novas a cada manhã; grande é a tua fidelidade.

versos.hebraico: חֶלְקִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אָמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י עַל־כֵּ֖ן אוֹחִ֥יל לֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
controles.kjv: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
controles.livre: O SENHOR é minha porção, diz a minha alma; portanto nele esperarei.

controles.web: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.
controles.kjv: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
controles.livre: Bom é o SENHOR para os que nele esperam, para a alma que o busca.

controles.web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.
controles.livre: É bom esperar e tranquilo aguardar a salvação do SENHOR.

controles.web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
controles.kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
controles.livre: É bom ao homem levar o jugo em sua juventude.

versos.hebraico: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
controles.kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
controles.livre: Sente-se só, e fique quieto; pois ele o pôs sobre si.

versos.hebraico: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽעָפָר֙ פִּ֔יהוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃

controles.web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.
controles.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
controles.livre: Ponha sua boca no pó; talvez haja esperança.

controles.web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him; let him be filled full with reproach.
controles.kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
controles.livre: Dê a face ao que o ferir; farte-se de insultos.

controles.web: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
controles.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
controles.livre: Pois o Senhor não rejeitará para sempre:

controles.web: For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
controles.kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
controles.livre: Mesmo que cause aflição, ele também se compadecerá segundo a grandeza de suas misericórdias.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִלִּבּ֔וֹ וַיַּגֶּ֖ה בְנֵי־אִֽישׁ׃ס

controles.web: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
controles.kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
controles.livre: Pois não é sua vontade  afligir nem entristecer os filhos dos homens.

versos.hebraico: לְדַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
controles.kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
controles.livre: Esmagar debaixo de seus pés a todos os prisioneiros da terra,

controles.web: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
controles.kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
controles.livre: Perverter o direito do homem diante da presença do Altíssimo,

versos.hebraico: לְעַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּרִיב֔וֹ אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה׃ס

controles.web: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
controles.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
controles.livre: Prejudicar ao homem em sua causa: o Senhor não aprova  ) tais coisas .

versos.hebraico: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַתֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה׃

controles.web: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
controles.kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
controles.livre: Quem é que pode fazer suceder algo que diz, se o Senhor não tiver mandado?

versos.hebraico: מִפִּ֤י עֶלְיוֹן֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָרָע֖וֹת וְהַטּֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
controles.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
controles.livre: Por acaso da boca do Altíssimo não sai tanto a maldição como a bênção?

controles.web: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
controles.kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
controles.livre: Por que o homem vivente se queixa da punição de seus próprios pecados?

controles.web: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.
controles.livre: Examinemos nossos caminhos, investiguemos, e nos voltemos ao SENHOR.

controles.web: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
controles.kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
controles.livre: Levantemos nossos corações e as mãos a Deus nos céus,

versos.hebraico: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֨עְנוּ֙ וּמָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ׃ס

controles.web: We have transgressed and have rebelled; you have not pardoned.
controles.kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Nós transgredimos e fomos rebeldes; tu não perdoaste.

versos.hebraico: סַכֹּ֤תָה בָאַף֙ וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵ֔נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃

controles.web: You have covered with anger and pursued us; you have killed, you have not pitied.
controles.kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
controles.livre: Cobriste-te de ira, e nos perseguiste; mataste sem teres compaixão.

controles.web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
controles.kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
controles.livre: Cobriste-te de nuvens, para que nossa oração não passasse.

controles.web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.
controles.kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
controles.livre: Tu nos tornaste como escória e rejeito no meio dos povos.

controles.web: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
controles.kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
controles.livre: Todos os nossos inimigos abriram sua boca contra nós.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֧חַד וָפַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖נוּ הַשֵּׁ֥את וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃

controles.web: Fear and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.
controles.kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
controles.livre: Medo e cova vieram sobre nós, devastação e destruição.

controles.web: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
controles.kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
controles.livre: Rios de águas correm de meus olhos, por causa da destruição da filha de meu povo.

versos.hebraico: עֵינִ֧י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֽוֹת׃

controles.web: My eye pours down, and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
controles.kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
controles.livre: Meus olhos destilam, e não cessam; não haverá descanso,

controles.web: Until Yahweh look down, and see from heaven.
controles.kjv: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.
controles.livre: Até que o SENHOR preste atenção, e veja desde os céus.

versos.hebraico: עֵינִי֙ עֽוֹלְלָ֣ה לְנַפְשִׁ֔י מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנ֥וֹת עִירִֽי׃ס

controles.web: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
controles.kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
controles.livre: Meus olhos afligem minha alma, por causa de todas as filhas de minha cidade.

controles.web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
controles.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
controles.livre: Sem motivo meus inimigos me caçam como a um passarinho.

controles.web: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
controles.kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
controles.livre: Tentaram tirar minha vida na masmorra, e lançaram pedras sobre mim.

controles.web: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.
controles.kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
controles.livre: As águas inundaram sobre minha cabeça; eu disse: É o meu fim.

controles.web: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
controles.kjv: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.
controles.livre: Invoquei o teu nome, SENHOR, desde a cova profunda.

versos.hebraico: קוֹלִ֖י שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵ֧ם אָזְנְךָ֛ לְרַוְחָתִ֖י לְשַׁוְעָתִֽי׃

controles.web: You heard my voice; don’t hide your ear at my breathing, at my cry.
controles.kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
controles.livre: Ouviste minha voz: não escondas o teu ouvido ao meu suspiro, ao meu clamor.

controles.web: You drew near in the day that I called on you; you said, Don’t be afraid.
controles.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
controles.livre: Tu te achegaste no dia em que te invoquei; disseste: Não temas.

versos.hebraico: רַ֧בְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֛י רִיבֵ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖י גָּאַ֥לְתָּ חַיָּֽי׃

controles.web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.
controles.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
controles.livre: Defendeste, Senhor, as causas de minha alma; redimiste minha vida.

controles.web: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
controles.kjv: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
controles.livre: Viste, SENHOR, a maldade que me fizeram; julga minha causa.

controles.web: You have seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.
controles.kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
controles.livre: Viste toda a vingança deles, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim.

controles.web: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their devices against me,
controles.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;
controles.livre: Ouvido os seus insultos, ó SENHOR, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim;

controles.web: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
controles.kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
controles.livre: As coisas ditas pelos que se levantam contra mim, e seu planos contra mim o dia todo.

controles.web: You see their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.
controles.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
controles.livre: Olha para tudo quanto eles fazem;  com canções zombam de mim.

versos.hebraico: תָּשִׁ֨יב לָהֶ֥ם גְּמ֛וּל יְהוָ֖ה כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: You will render to them a recompense, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
controles.kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.
controles.livre: Retribui-lhes, SENHOR, conforme a obra de suas mãos.

controles.web: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
controles.kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
controles.livre: Dá-lhes angústia  de coração, tua maldição a eles.

versos.hebraico: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּאַף֙ וְתַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.
controles.livre: Persegue-os com ira, e destrua-os de debaixo dos céus do SENHOR.
